source_title: Sooryavanshi storm brewing as India, New Zealand gear up for another run fest - India Today
source_excerpt:
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is set to return as India take on New Zealand in the second T20I in Christchurch. With another run fest on the cards, the 15-year-old's explosive batting could add firepower to India's aggressive approach.
"I was walking down the river yesterday, and a few Kiwi fans asked me, 'Is the 15-year-old kid playing tomorrow?'. He's warmed the bench long enough; you don't wanna lose his form."
These were supposedly the words of Ravi Shastri during the first T20I as everyone wanted a piece of Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in action. He has been protected by coach Gautam Gambhir and captain Shreyas Iyer , who seem to know his worth and believe that patience is the key. But the Indian fans have been impatient, and now their wish is finally being fulfilled.
Sooryavanshi will be back in the Indian team colours for the second match of the series in Christchurch. The boy wonder didn't play any of the matches in the home series against Afghanistan and the West Indies and has been more of an overseas expert so far. It did seem like the New Zealand tour would have also seen him continue his education with the squad, but Ishan Kishan's injury has opened the door for him to return.
And the numbers explain why there is so much hype around Sooryavanshi. The 15-year-old has scored 246 runs in eight T20Is with an average of 30.75 with a strike-rate of 186.36.
With the first match being a high-scoring thriller, fans will be expecting Sooryavanshi to play a major role in the outcome of the contest on Saturday. The first match was an indication that this Indian team won't be backing down from their apporach of attacking from the get-go.
India scored 93 for the loss of no wickets before the powerplay was done in their chase of 226. Sooryavanshi coming into this side will augur well for that mantra as he seems to have just one gear he is always in when it comes to T20 cricket.
But the hype has been tempered by the Indian management, who want to ensure that the youngster isn't overexposed .
"He is very talented and has a bright, bright future ahead. He will learn a lot of things once he starts playing. But, initially, I felt there was a lot of hype about (his spot in 11)," said Sitanshu Kothak.
"I genuinely felt it is not good for the player also. For a young 15-16 years old boy, everyone is saying that he should play and he is not getting the space. He is too young.
"It is sad and it is sad for other players also who are performing. People related to cricket, they should think about it. Whether they are actually helping, or just to create something, they are doing something."
Whatever happens on Saturday, Indian fans will expect Sooryavanshi to send the ball to all parts of the ground. NEW ZEALAND READY TO MAKE IT A SLUGFEST
When you look at the openers of New Zealand, it does seem like they can kill any contest with just brute force. Finn Allen and Tim Seifert is one of the best opening duo in the business and they put India under pressure early.
Often the middle-order has lacked the power that the Blackcaps have wanted in recent times but the first match was glimpse of what they can do. Glenn Phillips scored 82 off 40 balls and Bevon Jacobs chipped in with a top cameo.
But New Zealand's worry will be the form of Daryl Mitchell. He has often been the thorn on the side of India in ODIs, but batting in T20Is, especially at No.3 doesn't seem like a natural fit for him.
However, the fight from New Zealand is what that has made them a tough side to beat. When people do write them off, the Blackcaps have the knack of proving everyone wrong and then securing the win.
They showed that in the first match, where despite being hit early on, Mitchell Santner and Michael Bracewell were able to make the contest a tough one for India.
This Indian team does have some issues in the middle-order with Tilak Varma and Shreyas Iyer often getting stuck. While there is a new finisher in town in Naman Dhir, New Zealand will be backing themselves. advertisement IND VS NZ 2ND T20I: TEAM NEWS With Sooryavanshi expected to replace Kishan, India could pair him with Abhishek Sharma at the top, pushing Sanju Samson down to the third spot. This arrangement has been India's preferred option whenever all three have featured together, although it could hand New Zealand an early opportunity to exploit a potential weakness. The visitors could turn to off-spinners Michael Bracewell or Glenn Phillips during the powerplay to challenge India's left-handed opening combination. India have struggled against this particular match-up before, including during the opening phase of the T20 World Cup earlier this year. Beyond the potential change at the top, India are unlikely to make further adjustments to their batting order. Axar Patel could, however, be moved up the order if India need a batter capable of countering spin during the middle overs. IND VS NZ 2ND T20I: CHRISTCHURCH PITCH AND WEATHER REPORT Dew could be a major factor in Saturday's encounter and the remaining matches of the series, with all games scheduled for an 8pm start. This is likely to influence the toss, with captains expected to prefer bowling first to avoid defending a total under increasingly difficult conditions. advertisement However, the team batting first may find some encouragement in the surface, as the match will be played on the same pitch used on Thursday. Any wear from the opening game could offer a different challenge for the batters and bowlers. Christchurch is expected to enjoy clear skies and sunshine during the day, although the mercury is forecast to dip into the low teens Celsius by the time play gets underway. भारत और न्यूजीलैंड की टीमें क्राइस्टचर्च में खेले जाने वाले दूसरे टी20 मुकाबले के लिए तैयार हैं। ईशान किशन के चोटिल होने के कारण 15 वर्षीय वैभव सूर्यवंशी के इस मैच की प्लेइंग इलेवन में वापसी की उम्मीद है। यह मुकाबला शनिवार को स्थानीय समयानुसार रात 8:00 बजे शुरू होगा।

### मैच का विवरण और संदर्भ
- **टीमें:** भारत बनाम न्यूजीलैंड
- **प्रतियोगिता:** दूसरा टी20 मैच
- **स्थान:** क्राइस्टचर्च
- **तारीख और समय:** शनिवार, रात 8:00 बजे
- **फॉर्मेट:** टी20 इंटरनेशनल

### संभावित बदलाव और रणनीतियाँ
किशन की जगह सूर्यवंशी के आने की संभावना के साथ, वह अभिषेक शर्मा के साथ पारी की शुरुआत कर सकते हैं, जिससे संजू सैमसन तीसरे स्थान पर आ सकते हैं। न्यूजीलैंड पावरप्ले के दौरान बाएं हाथ की इस ओपनिंग जोड़ी के खिलाफ माइकल ब्रेसवेल या ग्लेन फिलिप्स जैसे ऑफ-स्पिनर्स का उपयोग कर सकता है।

### पिच और मौसम की स्थिति
रात 8:00 बजे शुरू होने वाले इस मैच में ओस एक बड़ा कारक बन सकती है, जिससे टॉस जीतकर पहले गेंदबाजी करने का फैसला प्रभावित हो सकता है। यह मैच गुरुवार को इस्तेमाल की गई पिच पर ही खेला जाएगा। मौसम विभाग के अनुसार दिन में आसमान साफ रहेगा और मैच शुरू होने तक तापमान गिरकर निचले टीन में पहुंच सकता है।

### संभावित प्लेइंग इलेवन
- **भारत:** अभिषेक शर्मा, वैभव सूर्यवंशी, संजू सैमसन (विकेटकीपर), श्रेयस अय्यर (कप्तान), तिलक वर्मा, नमन धीर, नीतीश कुमार रेड्डी, अक्षर पटेल, भुवनेश्वर कुमार, अर्शदीप सिंह, मयंक यादव
- **न्यूजीलैंड:** फिन एलन, टिम सीफर्ट (विकेटकीपर), डेरिल मिचेल, ग्लेन फिलिप्स, बेवन जैकॉब्स, माइकल ब्रेसवेल, मिचेल सैंटनर (कप्तान), नाथन स्मिथ, मैट हेनरी, एडम मिल्ने, लॉकी फर्ग्यूसन

en_body:
India and New Zealand are gearing up for the second T20I of the series in Christchurch, with 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi expected to return to the playing XI following an injury to Ishan Kishan. The upcoming fixture is scheduled for Saturday at 8:00 PM local time.

### Match Context and Team Setup
- **Teams:** India vs New Zealand
- **Competition:** Second T20I
- **Venue:** Christchurch
- **Date and Time:** Saturday, 8:00 PM start
- **Format:** T20 International

### Expected Changes and Tactics
With Sooryavanshi anticipated to step in for Kishan, reports indicate he may open alongside Abhishek Sharma, potentially shifting Sanju Samson to number three. New Zealand could utilize off-spinners like Michael Bracewell or Glenn Phillips during the powerplay to target India's left-handed opening pair.

### Pitch and Weather Conditions
Dew is expected to be a significant factor due to the 8:00 PM start time, which may influence the toss decision in favor of bowling first. The match will be played on the same pitch used on Thursday, potentially offering different challenges as the game progresses. Weather forecasts indicate clear skies during the day with temperatures dropping to the low teens Celsius by match time.

### Predicted Playing XIs
- **India:** Abhishek Sharma, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Sanju Samson (wk), Shreyas Iyer (capt), Tilak Varma, Naman Dhir, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Axar Patel, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Arshdeep Singh, Mayank Yadav
- **New Zealand:** Finn Allen, Tim Seifert (wk), Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Bevon Jacobs, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (capt), Nathan Smith, Matt Henry, Adam Milne, Lockie Ferguson
